description: VRAM needed to run a local LLM: weights + KV cache + overhead, and which common GPU sizes fit. Use a preset (llama31-8b, llama31-70b, qwen25-7b, qwen25-14b, qwen25-32b, qwen25-72b, qwen3-8b, qwen3-32b, mistral-7b, mistral-nemo, gemma2-9b, gemma2-27b, phi4-14b) or give params_b, layers, kv_heads, head_dim. Defaults: bits 4, context 8192, batch 1, kv_bits 16, overhead_pct 10. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.
